title: Monomial under coordinate permutation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\pi$ be a permutation of the $n$ coordinate indices, let $S$ be a subset of those indices, and let $x$ be a vector of $n$ signs. The monomial indexed by $S$ at the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $x_{\pi(i)}$ equals the monomial indexed by the image $\pi(S)$ at $x$.
